_comment: Realm security baseline (ADR 0014 §5, plan §4.5/§10): native brute-force detection (temporary lockout) + CONFIGURE_TOTP required action enabled (not a default action: MFA enrolment follows the tenant policy). Values = sim/pack defaults ⟨à valider⟩, same as banque-demo-realm.json; target thresholds are DB parameters. Applied to live realms by recette/setup-realm-security.py (not by merge-fragments.py: a partial requiredActions list in an import would drop Keycloak's default actions).
